text:
kevin: Heads-up — last night (~03:10 UTC) we saw a recurring aggregate anomaly for events-aggregation: large spikes + a set of missing spans in the traces. Opening this follow-up thread to coordinate remediations and owners. Postmortem draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-885

marta: Thanks. Is this tied to the deploy yesterday or a cron job? How frequent are the spikes?

kevin: Pattern looks like ~24h cadence since the 2024-10-02 consumer deploy. Correlates with consumer restarts and a reprocessing window misalignment (consumer occasionally replays 1m buckets that overlap). Logs show duplicate partial buckets then a downstream aggregator drop. Snippet from consumer logs: `WARN consumer: found overlap: start=2024-10-03T03:09:00Z end=2024-10-03T03:10:00Z`

sarah: I'll own the aggregation fix (normalize window boundaries + make aggregator idempotent). ETA: end of week for a safe fix + tests.

rahul: I can own the backfill and missing-span reconciliation. Need exact backfill window and a cost estimate for the heavy job. Plan: run dry-run on staging, then a controlled backfill in prod off-peak. Estimate 24-36h compute if we do full 7-day backfill.

anna: I'll take alerts + runbook updates: add an anomaly alert for 3 consecutive 1-min buckets > 2x baseline and a tracing alert for missing span rate > 0.5%. Will draft mitigation steps (how to pause consumer, re-run backfill, revert consumer).

infra-bot: Created ticket INC-4592 and linked PM-885. Assigned infra tag.

kevin: Acceptance criteria (putting this here so we agree):
- Aggregated metrics align with baseline within ±1% for at least 48h after fix
- Missing-span rate back to normal (<0.5%) for 48h
- Backfill completed and verified for affected window
- Runbook published with clear rollback/mitigation steps

sarah: Implementation plan (high-level):
1) PR to consumer to normalize window edges (prevent overlap) + add an idempotency guard in aggregator
2) Add unit/integration tests that simulate consumer restart overlap
3) Canary deploy to a single shard, monitor 6h, then roll.
Code sketch:```python
ROLLUP_MS = 60000
def normalize_window(ts_ms):
    return ts_ms - (ts_ms % ROLLUP_MS)
```
Will open PR today.

rahul: Backfill plan:
- Query to generate missing aggregates:```sql
INSERT INTO aggregates (bucket, key, value)
SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts), key, sum(val)
FROM events_raw
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2024-10-04'
GROUP BY 1,2;
```
- Dry-run on staging tomorrow, then prod backfill Tue 02:00-08:00 UTC (low traffic). Will shard by key to limit blast radius.

anna: Can you add a short verification script for post-backfill checks? I can add it to the runbook. Something like: compare `count(*)` per bucket vs historical baseline and diff threshold.

kevin: Good. Owners & rough dates:
- Aggregation bugfix: sarah — PR today, canary Thu 10/05, full roll Fri 10/06
- Backfill & reconciliation: rahul — staging dry-run Mon 10/03, prod backfill Tue 10/04 overnight
- Alerts & runbook: anna — draft by EOD Mon 10/03, publish after verification
- Postmortem updates + acceptance verification: kevin — coordinate, target close by 10/09

marta: One more ask: add a monitoring dashboard panel that shows `agg_delta_pct` per minute and `missing_span_rate` so we can visually validate. Could be part of the PR deploy checklist.

sarah: Will add dashboard panels and include them in the canary checklist.

rahul: I'll prepare an estimated compute/cost note in the INC ticket — want approval before running the full job.

infra-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check-in scheduled 1749950000 (Thu 10/05 14:00 UTC) — channel #incidents.

kevin: OK — tagging this a remediation sprint item. If anyone hits blockers, call it out here. Please update INC-4592 with PR links, runbook link, and backfill logs. :handshake:

anna: I'll post the runbook link once draft is ready. :eyes: 

kevin: Thanks all — we'll reconvene at the Thu check-in.
